find: WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?1) WHERE type <> 'text') THEN 0
replace: WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?1) WHERE json_type(value) <> 'text') THEN 0
note: Restores the old json_type(value) predicate: JSON1 re-parses each text element, so ordinary string arrays are refused as corrupt.
